# DoorDash: Last-Mile Logistics for Local Commerce
## Y Combinator Winter 2013

---

# Problem

## 95% of restaurant orders are NOT delivered

**Market Pain:**
- $86B US restaurant delivery market
- Only 5% penetration today
- Avg delivery time: 60+ minutes
- Customer satisfaction: 2.3/5

**Who Suffers:**

**500K+ US Restaurants**
- Cannot afford $50K+ fleet investment
- Lose 30% potential revenue
- Spend 20 hrs/week on logistics

**250M+ Customers**
- Limited to 10-15 restaurant options
- Unreliable delivery windows
- No real-time tracking
- Pay $8-12 for slow service

**5M Gig Workers**
- No flexible earning opportunities
- Gig economy growing 25% YoY

https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1526367790999-0150786686a2?w=1200

---

# Solution

## Three-Sided Marketplace Platform

**For Restaurants:**
✓ Go live in 48 hours, zero infrastructure
✓ Analytics dashboard + marketing tools
✓ 30% revenue increase ($15K/month avg)
✓ Zero capex, pay per order only

**For Customers:**
✓ 30 min faster (35 min vs 65 min competitors)
✓ Real-time GPS tracking
✓ 5,000+ local restaurants vs 200 on competitors
✓ 95% on-time delivery rate

**For Dashers:**
✓ Earn $22-28/hour (40% above minimum wage)
✓ 100% flexible schedule
✓ Same-day pay
✓ 92% satisfaction rate (industry-leading)

**Our Moat: Proprietary Logistics Algorithm**
- 30% faster delivery via ML-powered routing
- 45% better Dasher utilization
- Real-time optimization (traffic, weather, demand)

https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1556742049-0cfed4f6a45d?w=1200

---

# Product

## Customer Experience (3 Steps)

**1. Browse & Order** (2 min)
- 50+ nearby restaurants
- Smart ML recommendations
- One-tap reorder

**2. Track Real-Time** (35 min)
- Dasher on map
- Live ETA every 30 seconds
- In-app chat

**3. Receive & Rate** (1 min)
- Contactless delivery
- Photo proof
- Loyalty points

**Restaurant Dashboard:**
- Real-time order management
- Revenue analytics (daily/weekly/monthly)
- Marketing campaigns
- Peak hour insights

**Dasher App:**
- Smart auto-dispatch
- See earnings before accepting
- Batch orders for efficiency
- Voice navigation

https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1556742111-a301076d9d18?w=1200

---

# Business Model

## Multiple Revenue Streams

**Revenue Sources:**
1. Restaurant commission: 20-30% → $7/order
2. Delivery fees: $3.99-$6.99 → $5/order
3. DashPass subscription: $9.99/month (400K subscribers, 85% retention)

**Unit Economics (Current):**
- Gross revenue: $12/order
- Dasher pay: -$7
- Other costs: -$0.90
- **Contribution margin: $4.10 (34%)**

**Unit Economics (At Scale):**
- Gross revenue: $13/order
- Dasher pay: -$6.50 (routing efficiency)
- Other costs: -$0.80
- **Contribution margin: $5.70 (44%)**

**Network Effect Flywheel:**
More Restaurants → More Choice → More Orders → More Dashers → Faster Delivery → More Restaurants

**Key Metrics:**
- Current: 8% gross margin, $200K/month burn
- Target: 15% gross margin, city breakeven Month 18

https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1554224311-beee2ece4baa?w=1200

---

# Market Size

## $200B+ Total Opportunity

**TAM: $86B** (US Restaurant Delivery)
- $863B US restaurant industry
- 65% delivery-suitable = $561B
- 15% penetration = $86B TAM
- Growing 15% annually

**SAM: $25B** (Top 50 US Metro Areas)
- 350M addressable customers
- Urban/suburban density economics

**SOM: $2.5B** (Year 5 Target)
- 10% market share in 50 cities
- 25M active customers
- 100K restaurant partners

**Growth Drivers:**
- Smartphone penetration: 85% → 95%
- Gig economy: 25% YoY growth
- Food delivery habit: 12% → 35% by 2020
- Urbanization: 80% in metros

**Expansion Markets:**
- **Year 1-2:** Food delivery ($86B)
- **Year 3-4:** Grocery + convenience ($85B)
- **Year 5-7:** All local commerce ($200B+)

**Market Math:**
```
1,000 × $1B × 0.1% = $1B
```
**1,000** Series A founders × **$1B** potential (7% at IPO) × **0.1%** IPO rate = **$1B** equity value

**Our Potential:**
- $86B × 10% share × 20% take rate = **$1.7B revenue**
- At 5x multiple = **$8.5B valuation**
- Founder equity: 15-20%
- **Outcome: $1.2B-$1.7B founder value**

https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1460925895917-afdab827c52f?w=1200

# Competition

## Winner-Take-Most Dynamics

**Competitive Landscape:**

**Seamless/GrubHub** - $500M revenue, 5M users
- ❌ Pure aggregator, no delivery fleet
- ✅ We own end-to-end experience
- ⏱️ 65 min avg vs our 35 min

**Traditional Delivery** (Pizza chains)
- ❌ Single restaurant only
- ✅ We offer 5,000+ choices

**Postmates** - San Francisco, emerging
- ❌ Courier model, weak unit economics
- ✅ Restaurant-focused, better margins

**Uber** - Rumored food delivery entry
- ❌ No restaurant relationships
- ✅ 18-month head start, 5K partnerships

**Our 3 Moats:**

**1. Proprietary Algorithm**
- 30% faster delivery times
- 45% better Dasher efficiency
- 95% on-time vs 78% industry
- 2M+ deliveries analyzed

**2. Restaurant Depth**
- NPS: 72 vs 45 competitors
- 89% would recommend
- 350+ exclusive partnerships
- High switching costs (training, setup, reviews)

**3. Network Effects**
- Palo Alto case study: 65% market share
- 85% restaurant coverage
- 28 min delivery vs 58 min competitors
- Winner-take-most outcome

| Metric | DoorDash | Seamless | Postmates | Traditional |
|--------|----------|----------|-----------|-------------|
| Speed | 35 min | 65 min | 55 min | 45 min |
| Restaurants | 5,000+ | 8,000 | 1,500 | 1 |
| Own Delivery | ✓ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Tracking | ✓ | ✗ | ✓ | ✗ |
| Tools | ✓✓✓ | ✓ | ✗ | ✗ |
| Economics | Strong | N/A | Weak | Strong |

https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551288049-bebda4e38f71?w=1200

# Financials

## Path to $50M ARR in 3 Years

**Historical Growth:**
- Month 1: $1K MRR, 100 orders
- Month 12: $65K MRR, 12K orders
- Month 18: $167K MRR, 50K orders
- **38% monthly revenue CAGR**

**Projections (Conservative):**

**Year 1 (Current):**
- $2M ARR, 50K orders/month, 15 cities
- 8% gross margin, -$2.4M EBITDA
- $200K/month burn

**Year 2 (With $2.5M):**
- $15M ARR (+650%), 400K orders/month, 50 cities
- 12% gross margin, -$6M EBITDA
- $500K/month burn

**Year 3:**
- $50M ARR (+233%), 1.5M orders/month, 100 cities
- 15% gross margin, -$2M EBITDA
- Breakeven Q4

**Year 4:**
- $150M ARR (+200%), 4.5M orders/month, 150 cities
- 18% gross margin, +$15M EBITDA
- **Profitable**

**Year 5:**
- $350M ARR (+133%), 10M orders/month, 200 cities
- 20% gross margin, +$50M EBITDA

**Unit Economics Evolution:**

**Current:** $12 revenue - $8 costs = **$4 margin (33%)**

**At Scale:** $14 revenue - $7.50 costs = **$6.50 margin (46%)**

**Customer LTV Journey:**
- Month 1: $18 revenue, $6 margin, ROI 33%
- Month 6: $96 revenue, $32 margin, ROI 178%
- Month 12: $180 revenue, $60 margin, ROI 333%
- Month 24: $336 revenue, **$112 LTV**, LTV:CAC **6.2:1**

**Path to $10B Valuation:**
- Year 3: $50M × 6x = $300M valuation
- Year 5: $350M × 8x = $2.8B valuation
- Year 7: $1B × 10x = $10B valuation
- Comparable: GrubHub IPO $2.7B at $385M revenue
